# A commitment to people.

I'm Leia George. My interests bring together clinical care, mental health research, and the science of how we heal.

My background spans medical physiology and biophysics, hands-on clinical support, and research with a focus on mental health. I'm particularly interested in addiction, depression, and the experiences that shape patient care.

[Explore my experience](experience.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Get in touch](mailto:lxg401@case.edu){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
